title: SNOW PATROL
by: Claude Code session, drafted from the SNOW PATROL README

promise.text: The mountain is the world. The patrol station is home. You run the mountain patrol for the Kessel valley: its slopes, its roads, its village and the people who get lost on it.
promise.source: README.md tagline and first paragraph (drafted, not stated as a vision by a person)

context.text: Third-person, iPhone first, plays in the browser; progress saves and Continue picks up mid-mission.

identity.text: Colorado high country: exposed granite, blowing snow and a working avalanche operation; Vince, the newest hand, and Koda, a grey-and-white husky with one ear that never stands up.

pillars.text: A working patrol day: wake in the lodge, pick a call or free patrol, do the job, get paid, build up the station, sleep into a new forecast.
Avalanche control and rescue as real procedures: danger rating, control route, howitzer and hand charges, transceiver search, probe and dig.
Koda is useful without being a tool: a companion with a job, a personality and a bond that grows.
One hand-laid 2 km valley to cross on foot, by snowmobile, helicopter and skis, with tricks in the air.
